name: Char's Encore
source:
A sequel doujin Gundam visual novel. After months of uneasy normality following the events of CHAR'S ENNUI, Char's innocuous tour of the Sazabi with a hostage Amuro forces into light all that their previous encounter left unresolved, and long-simmering tensions reach a climax.
